<script>
(function () {
  var s = document.querySelectorAll("#tadpole-banner img"), i = 0;
  if (s.length < 2) return;
  setInterval(function () {
    s[i].classList.remove("active");
    i = (i + 1) % s.length;
    s[i].classList.add("active");
  }, 5000);
})();
</script>
